user.title: Set up Vinted Go
user.description: Enter the e-mail address of your Vinted Go account. Vinted Go will send you a verification link — no password needed.

verify.title: Enter the verification link
verify.description: Open the e-mail Vinted Go just sent to {email} and paste the verification link (or just its token) here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Vinted Go
reauth_confirm.description: Your Vinted Go session for {email} has expired. Continue to receive a fresh verification link by e-mail.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Vinted Go. Please try again.
error.invalid_token: That verification link or token is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

abort.already_configured: This Vinted Go account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: The verification link is for a different Vinted Go account than the one being reconnected.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

data_description.refresh_interval: How often the integration checks Vinted Go for parcel updates. A slower interval is gentler on Vinted Go's API; the default of 30 minutes is plenty for most parcels.
